name: eval-pipeline
description: Load a real eval dataset off disk, score every case against a shared rubric, then synthesize the per-case results into one report. `load-cases` (a deterministic code phase) reads the dataset's `rows` into a JSON array stored as ${cases}; the `map` fans out over that array — each case is the body's ${item}, with ${item.input} carrying its EXPECTED/OUTPUT/CRITERIA — and `synthesize` consolidates the verdicts. Re-target by changing vars.datasetPath to any dataset.

vars.rubric: Score the OUTPUT 1-5 on correctness against the EXPECTED/CRITERIA (5 = fully correct, 1 = contradicts/fabricates/omits required facts). Justify the score in one sentence and end with a PASS (>=4) or FAIL (<4) verdict.

phases.name: load-cases
phases.description: Read the eval dataset off disk (deterministic, zero-token) and emit its `rows` as a JSON array, stored as ${cases} for the map to fan out over. The path is ${datasetPath} relative to the repo root; the script resolves the root from the launch env so it stays portable. (code.run needs SAMMY_ALLOW_CODE_RUN=1 on the server.)

code.run:
set -e
REL="${datasetPath}"
for ROOT in "$npm_config_local_prefix/.." "$INIT_CWD" "$PWD/.." "$PWD"; do
  F="$ROOT/$REL"
  if [ -f "$F" ]; then
    exec python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(open(sys.argv[1])); rows=d.get("rows") if isinstance(d,dict) else d; print(json.dumps(rows))' "$F"
  fi
done
echo '[]'

phases.name: score-cases
phases.description: Score every real eval case against the shared rubric.

body.name: score-one

phases.name: synthesize
phases.description: Consolidate the per-case scores into a single eval report.
